arguments.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: single Johnny Castaway game sprite, appearance review.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent RGBA background, isolated character or deliberate partial sprite, clear padding around visible silhouette, no floor or cast shadow.
Reference roles: Image 1 is exact original pose enlarged by nearest-neighbor; image 2 is its original-family contact sheet to disambiguate black shapes against light background and understand neighboring phases; image 3 is approved Johnny identity/drawing language; image 4 is later approved lighter skin palette. Original controls pose, clothing, crop and expression. Identity images control face, full scruffy beard, shaggy hair and lean build only.
Style: polished smooth 2D cartoon, confident bold black contours, clean cel shading with a little soft form, no pixelation or diagnostic red-white checker colors. Skin warm light peach-orange matching final palette reference. Long rounded nose and full dark-brown scruffy beard.
SOURCE COSTUME OVERRIDE: this family wears BLACK TOP HAT, BLACK TAILCOAT with long back tails, BLACK TROUSERS, white shirt, bright blue waistcoat/front lapels and red bow tie. Bare feet. Do not substitute sailor cap or shorts from identity reference. Keep lean human cartoon proportions.
Constraints: source-view face visibility, anatomically connected shoulder-elbow-hand paths, exactly source-visible limbs, consistent tailcoat. No extra prop, person, label, grid, watermark, solid background, opaque gray source ground shadow or fake checkerboard.
Specific original pose/action: Johnny runs right, torso pitched forward, right-facing profile with one eye looking ahead. Near arm swings backward with elbow behind waist at screen-left and hand near lower ribs; far arm bends forward from far shoulder, visible fist ahead at lower chest on right. Forward supporting leg extends to foot flat at lower right; rear leg folds sharply with bare foot raised behind at screen-left. Coat tails lift left. Full body.
